name: caveman
description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Derived from Matt Pocock's MIT-licensed caveman skill (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) with this repo's `cs-caveman-mode` persona agent + `/cs:caveman` slash command wrapper and stdlib Python tooling (compressor, token-savings estimator, lint). Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /cs:caveman.

attribution.derivation_note: Matt's SKILL.md content reproduced under MIT. Additions: cs-* persona agent + /cs:* command wrapper, stdlib compression/estimator/lint tooling.
